parameters.help_en:
The performance monitoring metrics. You can specify multiple metrics in a single request. Separate multiple metrics with commas (,).
For more information about performance monitoring metrics, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186703.html
parameters.help_zh:
性能监控指标，允许一次传入多个指标进行查询，多个指标参数间用英文逗号（,）隔开。
更多关于性能监控指标详情，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186703.html
parameters.name: key

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. Specify a UNIX timestamp in UTC. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the query. Specify a UNIX timestamp in UTC. Unit: milliseconds.

If the query time range is less than 1 hour, the data within 1 hour before the end time is returned
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为毫秒。

如果查询时间范围小于1小时，会返回结束时间前1小时的数据
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The multiplier for the monitoring data collection period. For example, the default data collection period for each resource monitoring metric is 1 minute. If you set the period multiplier to 2, the data collection period for the current resource monitoring metric is 2 minutes
parameters.help_zh: 监控数据周期倍数。例如，各资源监控项的数据采集周期均默认为1分钟，若设置周期倍数为2，则表示当前资源监控项数据采集周期为2分钟
parameters.name: period_multiple
